messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 12):
"""
If yes, furnish the information in Section VIII. If no, furnish a certification from the Appointed Actuary that there is no effect on the pricing of the product. YES/NO 1.12 Expected loss ratio & Combined Ratio (for the product) at the time of filing the product or modification of the product, as the case may be vis-a-vis the actual incurred loss ratio & actual Combined Ratio (Data to be furnished separately for each three preceding Financial Years) FY Loss Ratio % Combined Ratio% Expect ed Actual Expe cted Actual 1.13 Number of Plans or Variants or options within the Product and Nomenclature Used Name of the Base Product Number of plans or variants or Options Name of plan or variant or option (Mention each name separately in each sentence) 1.14 Within how many days the Insurer is proposing to launch the new product.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What information must an insurer provide regarding loss ratios when filing a new health insurance product or modifying an existing one?","answer":"The insurer must furnish the expected loss ratio and combined ratio for the product at the time of filing, along with the actual incurred loss ratio and actual combined ratio for each of the three preceding financial years.","facts":["Expected loss ratio & Combined Ratio (for the product) at the time of filing the product or modification of the product","Data to be furnished separately for each three preceding Financial Years"]},{"question":"If a product modification does not affect pricing, what certification is required?","answer":"The insurer must provide a certification from the Appointed Actuary stating that there is no effect on the pricing of the product.","facts":["furnish a certification from the Appointed Actuary that there is no effect on the pricing of the product"]}]}
